title: Obscured but Not Erased: Evaluating Nationality Bias in LLMs via Name-Based Bias Benchmarks

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual substitution of explicit nationality labels with culturally indicative names in multiple-choice question-answering prompts (derived from the BBQ dataset), measuring accuracy, stereotype-aligned bias scores, and Error Retention Ratios across ambiguous and disambiguated contexts.
